name: generate-claude-md
description: Generate a lean, high-signal CLAUDE.md from codebase analysis. Grounded in Anthropic best practices and empirical studies; built to pass review-claude-md's critical checks.

interface.shortDescription: Generate a lean CLAUDE.md for a repo
interface.longDescription: Scans a repository's manifests, CI and config, verifies its build, test and lint commands, and writes a short, project-specific CLAUDE.md that a bundled validator checks against review-claude-md's critical rules.
defaultPrompt: Use $generate-claude-md to write a lean CLAUDE.md for this repository.
Use $generate-claude-md to preview a CLAUDE.md for this repo without writing it.
Use $generate-claude-md to refresh the existing CLAUDE.md, keeping my custom sections.
